name: @yottameta/yotta-lesson
description: YuanAn (yotta-lesson) — a local, deterministic lesson-plan skeleton and coverage checker for AI agents: reads a curriculum map (lesson id, knowledge points, key points, difficulties, misconceptions, standard reference) plus an optional structure config, builds a lesson skeleton whose stage minutes always sum to periods x minutes-per-period and whose objectives each carry a curriculum-standard source, and checks an existing lesson text for missing knowledge points, missing required stages, missing citations, missing time annotations and total-time mismatches. Markdown and JSON output, configurable stages, and a CI gate are included. Triggers: drafting a lesson or study-plan skeleton, verifying a lesson against a curriculum map, checking that knowledge points and stages are covered, or wiring lesson-structure checks into automation. Boundaries: structural skeleton and gap list only — no exercise content, no student comments, no replacement for the teacher's instructional design; no network access, no model calls, no upload of lesson plans or school maps; no textbook, curriculum or exam text is bundled, and citations must be verified against official sources. Fully local, zero-dependency (Python 3.8+ standard library).
